data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided SCI journal method figure (v12) with small, precise corrections while preserving the overall composition, high-quality pictorial thumbnails, teal/orange/red frames, wall/aperture sketch, wide layout, and polished vector-like style. Do not redesign from scratch.

Make the following exact scientific-forward-flow corrections:
1) Keep the left-side active stereo / geometry stream producing raw depth D_raw and scene/material mask Omega.
2) Remove any arrow from the active stereo sketch or geometry stream into the camera-register box. Camera registers c=[P,E,G] must be an independent input into S_phi, not an output of geometry or the renderer.
3) Remove any arrow from D_raw or Omega into the camera-register box.
4) Add clean black arrows from D_raw and Omega directly into the S_phi sensor block / its relevant factor modules.
5) Add a clean black arrow from camera registers c=[P,E,G] into the S_phi sensor block / relevant factor modules.
6) Add a small black arrow from speed ||v_t|| into the motion blur row only.
7) Inside S_phi, show five factor rows feeding a common combiner/bracket that merges into quality Q. Ensure all five rows contribute to Q, not only active return.
8) Use these dependencies inside the rows:
   - active return uses (P, D_raw)
   - ambient washout uses (E, Omega)
   - motion blur uses (E, ||v_t||)
   - gain/noise uses (G)
   - edge difficulty uses (D_raw)
9) Draw Q -> soft validity M -> straight-through mask M_ST.
10) Draw output composition explicitly: D_obs = D_raw x M_ST and Q_obs = Q x M_ST. D_raw must visibly participate in D_obs; Q must visibly participate in Q_obs; M_ST must feed both outputs.

Text / label corrections:
- Bottom-left note should read exactly: "Omega in [0,1]: scene/material mask".
- Soft validity formula can be compactly shown as: "M = sigmoid((Q - q0) / sigma_q)".
- Keep compact formulas only:
  "Q = clip(Q0 + Omega C_rho, 0, 1)"
  "M = sigmoid((Q - q0) / sigma_q)"
  "D_obs = D_raw x M_ST"
  "Q_obs = Q x M_ST"
- Keep all labels large and horizontal.

Style / constraints:
- Preserve the existing mini-panels: wall/aperture sketch, range/return image, washed/noisy surface, motion blur, speckled gain noise, edge difficulty heatmap, depth and quality maps.
- Keep a clean SCI journal vector-like style.
- Use only black/dark-gray forward arrows.
- No red dashed arrows, no gradient arrows, no loss box, no red lines.
- Do not imply S_phi outputs x, c, or camera state.
- Do not imply the native renderer R is differentiable inside the sensor branch.

Make the edits subtle and precise, keeping the figure readable and faithful to the original layout.
